parallel.requirements: The run recognized the reverse-engineering benchmark: infer goimports-reviser behavior by running the bundled binary and documentation, then write an original executable without source lookup, wrapping, or binary analysis.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent kept final implementation implicit and delegated nine broad behavior-research reports covering import sorting, project grouping, rm-unused, aliases, format, output modes, targets, imports-order, and cache details.
parallel.implementation: No fresh reimplementation was created. Work consisted of README/help/version inspection and many scratch probes under temporary directories, plus reports from children.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: No child produced code to integrate. The archived artifact contained the original workspace plus scratch probe fixtures such as f2, images, README, LICENSE, and executable rather than a new compilable solution.
parallel.verification: The children collected behavioral observations, but the parent never reached integrated build or evaluator-aligned verification of an original executable.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run timed out with one child cancelled, the parent cancelled, and only a truncated aggregate swarm result preview after cancellation.

serial.requirements: The serial run recognized the same cleanroom reverse-engineering rules and explored the provided executable and README without using subagents.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single main agent owned all probing and intended later implementation itself, using a running todo list to move through behavior areas sequentially.
serial.implementation: No fresh reimplementation was produced; the run remained in behavioral probes for directories, excludes, generated files, flags, cache, output, and write semantics.
serial.integration_and_delivery: There was no integrated implementation or build artifact. The archived artifact was essentially the original workspace contents, not a new compilable replacement.
serial.verification: The serial run verified individual observed behaviors with shell probes but never built or tested a submitted implementation.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial main agent was cancelled during further probing, before creating code or delivering an executable, so the official evaluator failed at compile time.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the cleanroom reimplementation requirement and its restrictions, then framed the executable as goimports-reviser behavior to map by probing.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same prompt and kept probing the executable behavior directly under the same cleanroom restrictions.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition difference caused the outcome; both knew the task but neither reached the required implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed discovery into nine child reports while the parent implicitly reserved final implementation after report aggregation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used no child agents and kept research and any future implementation in one continuous main-agent path.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The main process difference is fan-out: parallel spread discovery broadly across nine probe-only children, while serial had no delegation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs included shared context, strict cleanroom rules, probe method, and area-specific behavioral reporting instructions.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no cross-agent interface and carried all gathered context in the single main trajectory.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No missing brief, interface contract, stale handoff, or conflicting handoff independently explains the failure; the child work was research reports rather than interoperating components.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel stayed in behavioral discovery; the parent never began writing the replacement implementation after the reports.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also stayed in behavioral discovery, still probing excludes and write semantics near the end.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both lacked implementation, but parallel spent its path on delegated report aggregation while serial spent it on sequential probes.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent launched the swarm, one child was cancelled while still active, and the parent was cancelled before it could consume the full aggregate into an implementation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results to join and ended with the main trajectory itself being cancelled.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had an unfinished child and late aggregate preview; serial had only its own unfinished main-agent work.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children worked in scratch probe areas and did not produce competing implementation files to merge into the final workspace.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used scratch probes in one trajectory and similarly never integrated an implementation into the final workspace.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No shared-state collision or contamination is evidenced; both final artifacts lacked a new implementation, with parallel additionally leaving probe fixtures in the artifact.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel accumulated behavioral probe observations but never performed integrated verification of a reimplementation before cancellation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial performed local probe checks but never built or verified a submitted implementation before cancellation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both official evaluations failed at compile time, so neither had whole-task acceptance evidence.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used one AgentSwarm call, nine subagents, 322 LLM requests, over ten million tokens, and timed out before closing the implementation loop.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used 68 LLM requests with no subagents and also timed out before implementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a specific coordination cost: broad fan-out consumed substantially more budget and left the parent cancelled at aggregation, while serial simply continued one long probe path.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official evaluations are not discordant: parallel and serial both failed at compile time with 597 tests not run. The substantive process difference is that parallel consumed its run in a nine-child discovery fan-out and report aggregation, while serial consumed its run in a single continuous investigation path. Neither delivered an original replacement executable, so the retained parallel pattern is an adverse process episode but not an explanation for an official score difference.
parallel_contributors: Nine broad child investigations displaced implementation and left one child and the parent cancelled.
The parent received only an oversized aggregate preview after cancellation and never converted findings into code.
serial_contributors: The serial run did not use delegation and remained in direct probing until main-agent cancellation.
It also never produced or verified a fresh implementation.
ordinary_implementation_differences: No ordinary coding difference explains the score because neither run reached a substantive implementation.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained pattern is a parallel process harm, not an official score differential
